settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.description: Playback setting title. Immediate D-pad jumps while controls are hidden; default Off.

settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.c.value: With controls hidden, Left/Right jumps by the skip interval. With controls visible, OK confirms. Off keeps reveal-first navigation.
settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.c.description: Explanation of optional D-pad seeking. Dedicated rewind and fast-forward work independently.

settings.playback.episode_navigation_but.description: Playback setting title. Previous/Next episode buttons; default On.

settings.playback.episode_navigation_but.value: Show Previous and Next for episode queues. Previous restarts at five seconds; before that it plays the previous episode.
settings.playback.episode_navigation_but.description: Explanation of episode queue buttons and the five-second restart rule.

settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.o.description: Switch choice shared by the independent playback options.
